prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: ground-only background plate for a top-down oblique 2D pixel-art magic academy RPG plaza, landscape 10:7.
Reference image 1 is the art direction and material reference. Isolate and reconstruct the limestone pavement visible around and below the fountain as if the entire scene were cleared of its raised objects. Use its golden hour lighting, imperfect limestone, rich leaf clusters, crisp artist-made pixel texture and compass rose.
Paint continuous fully walkable stone paving edge to edge. View straight ahead on one horizontal axis at a steep top-down 3/4 camera like the reference: horizontal grout lines, staggered perpendicular joints, no diagonal/isometric camera and no vanishing point. One integrated 8-point thin pale-gold compass rose in a subtle taupe stone medallion, center at (50%, 73%), about 18% of width, foreshortened naturally. Elegant occasional running bands of pale trim and split seams laid into the surface, including a subtle recessed elliptical paving band around the upper-middle focal zone, left and right ends open to connect to the rest of the campus. Make the floor interesting even where empty using variation in paving block widths, small chips, short old hairline cracks, and clusters of golden maple leaves naturally caught in mortar joints. Strong warm shafts of afternoon sunlight angled upper right to lower left. Broken silhouette of off-frame tree canopy shadows across paving, soft grey lavender taupe stone in shade and warm honey ivory in sun. Keep stone joints natural and understated so the surface reads as believable game-scale masonry, with roughly 15 paving courses. No artificial vignette. No gradient fog. Fine intentional cluster-based pixel edges, absolutely no blur, no painterly smearing, no photorealism.
Strictly only horizontal flooring and scattered fallen leaves. No wall, steps, railings, raised curbs, objects, fountain, furniture, lamps, vegetation, trees, grass, flowers, people, sky or text. The visible open floor remains completely navigable across the whole frame.
